description: This file defines the Affiliate model class within the OpenCart admin module for marketing. It contains methods to manage affiliate data such as adding, editing, deleting, retrieving individual records, lists, and reports related to customer affiliates.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: A model class for managing customer affiliate data within the OpenCart admin system, including CRUD operations and report retrieval.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new affiliate record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing affiliate record for a specific customer.

methods.name: editBalance
methods.description: Sets the balance for a specific customer affiliate.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Removes an affiliate record and associated reports for a given customer.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an affiliate by customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Retrieves affiliate info based on tracking code.

methods.name: getAffiliates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of affiliates with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalAffiliates
methods.description: Returns the total count of affiliate records with optional filters.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Provides affiliate report data for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports associated with a customer.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of reports for a customer.
